name: 55th Child Neurology Society Annual Meeting
description: The Child Neurology Society holds its 55th annual meeting in Montreal, Quebec, with scientific sessions and abstract presentations in pediatric neurology. A resident seminar on epilepsy precedes the main program on October 12 and 13.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission
deadlines.note: Deadline confirmed via the Child Neurology Society official social media announcement; the abstracts page no longer displayed the date at time of access because submissions had closed.

deadlines.label: Abstract withdrawal deadline
deadlines.note: No abstracts may be withdrawn after this date.

deadlines.label: Encore abstract eligibility cutoff
deadlines.note: Abstracts presented elsewhere within 12 months of this date are not eligible as encore submissions.

sources.note: Confirms dates October 14-17, 2026, venue Palais des congres de Montreal, and pre-meeting resident seminar dates.

name: 56th Child Neurology Society Annual Meeting
description: The Child Neurology Society holds its 56th annual meeting in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The program covers research and clinical practice in pediatric neurology.

sources.note: Official event page states dates November 10-13, 2027, in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.
Earlier official announcement (2024) confirms Milwaukee as the host city, stating only 'November 2027' without exact dates.

notes: Exact dates (Nov 10-13, 2027) appear only on the single official event page found; the original 2024 host-city announcement gave only the month. Venue and abstract/registration deadlines are not yet published. Coordinates are for Milwaukee city center since no venue is named.
